reviews.text:
We recently had our pool and spa built by Pinnacle Pool and Spa, and we are thrilled with the outcome. They did a truly fantastic job, and the entire experience exceeded our expectations.

From the initial design phase through construction and final inspection. The quality of the workmanship is apparent in every corner of the project.

We absolutely love our new pool. It has transformed our backyard into the perfect oasis, and we couldn't be happier with how beautiful and functional it is.

If you are considering building a pool, we definitely recommend Pinnacle Pool and Spa. They deliver high-quality results. Trust the process!!
reviews.author: Luis Valdes

reviews.text: Prior to contacting Pinnacle Pools ( Mason) I received several bids on a pool installation for our uniquely shaped small yard. Mason was able to provide a design for our yard and we loved it. The communication was amazing throughout the process. I would definitely recommend this company for anyone who's interested in a gunite pool.
reviews.author: Wil T.

reviews.text:
From the beginning Pinnacle Pools stood out as we were getting quotes from other pool builders. Festus listened to exactly what we were looking for. No cross-sell. No up-sell. No high pressure. A beautiful design at a very reasonable price. We made the initial deposit and of course made a few small changes after that. Did they take the opportunity to bump our cost? No. They simply made our changes at no additional charge. You don’t see that every often.

Then the construction. We’d built a pool in the past. We knew the process. But we’d never seen such fast efficient and professional crews. From the excavation, to the gunite, to the electrical/plumbing, to the concrete and plaster. A little over six (6) week start to finish to build a 40’ by 10’ pool on a 55’ by 25’ patio. Beyond inpressive.

There were a few hiccups and concerns we had. Sean handled them (resolved them) all. The result. We couldn’t be happier. Pinnacle Pools A+
reviews.author: Gary Hardy

reviews.text: We built our first pool with Pinnacle and it was a fantastic experience. Since the beginning, Festus, Josh and the rest of the team walked us through the entire process. They explained everything and guided us through the design and selection process. Once construction started they kept us informed every day of the progress and what to expect over the next few days. The work was completed on time and with excellent quality. We love our pool and we know we’ll enjoy it for many years to come. Definitely recommend, 5-stars all the way.
reviews.author: Sergio O Zonta

reviews.text:
We just finished our build with Pinnacle and I will let the pics speak for themselves! Although we got our work ahead with landscaping the pool itself and the pavers are absolutely BEAUTIFUL. We never thought our backyard could have this potential, but the guys at Pinnacle saw something different and we are very pleased they did!
Our original sales rep ended up leaving the company right in the middle of getting the permits approved which did delay the process, but once that got resolved and Cooper was assigned to our build things went very smoothly and the communication was always delivered, which was most important to us. Of all years summer of 2025 had ALOT of rain and despite the rain from our dig date and our fill date our pool was completed in exactly 2 months. Not too shabby 😁
reviews.author: christy flores

reviews.text: Soon it will be a year since our pool was completed. It took longer than my other friends to finish with other companies (5 months), but we have had no major problems unlike my friends. The pool is beautiful, the equipment is high quality, and the company checked in with us to see how things were going during the winter. The only issue we have had is a crack that needs to be re-caulked in a corner. Thanks for helping us get the backyard oasis we always dreamed of.
reviews.author: Lynette Snyder

reviews.text:
I don't usually post reviews, but I feel I would be doing a disservice to the community if I didn't send my review.
Our pool build has been a wonderful experience. Right from the first time, I walked into the Pinnacle Pool office in Richardson. I was given a very warm reception. Zach, the salesperson, was very detailed. Zach was very patient and took his time to develop the design we wanted. Zach also helped with the material selection, and in the end, it was a gorgeous and elegant pool
The build process was also very smooth and timely. Cooper the project manager was very professional. He made sure to talk to us and update us on every step throughout the build process.
Pinnacle delivered in a timely manner, kept their word, and there were no hidden charges or “surprises.” Overall, these guys are so good, and they are responsive. They were there to troubleshoot our little issues, even weeks after completing the project.
The pool is so beautiful that a neighbor signed up with Pinnacle at the first sight of my pool. If you are looking to build a quality luxury pool at a competitive price and in a timely fashion, give these guys a call, and you won't be disappointed
reviews.author: Jude Okeke

reviews.text:
We had a great build with Festus, Cooper and team. Just like any large project there were a few hiccups along the way but ultimately ending with a beautiful pool and great design by Festus. We look forward to enjoying this space for years to come. Broke ground in May and jumped in end of July.

5 star review also for Brody with Pinnacle Pool Service. We had a rough intial pool school with another associate, unfortunately communication just broke down a bit and we were told he is new to teaching, but Brody came over and was super helpful and knowledgeable with “Pool School” Thank you so much for taking time with us and not rushing off. He answered all of our questions and follow up text.
reviews.author: Sarah Aguinaga
